criteria.expected: One app row renders selected child artwork; summary does not cause generic information fallback; replacement and refresh retain correct artwork.
criteria.initial_state: Connected OS listener; app posts children and newer summary with distinct artwork.
criteria.invariants: Preserve grouping/profile identity, badge membership, async off-main loading, obsolete-result isolation, tap navigation and notification data. No geometry changes.
criteria.trigger: Home row renders, notifications update/remove, listener refreshes.

description: A child notification chosen for Home must retain its matching platform icon even when a newer group summary exists.
title: Keep notification row artwork for grouped apps
